mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT related.S_INFO_WINDCODE FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_windcustomcode current_code INNER JOIN ais_inv_ods.wind_windcustomcode related ON related.S_INFO_ISINCODE = current_code.S_INFO_ISINCODE WHERE current_code.S_INFO_WINDCODE = #{windCode} AND current_code.S_INFO_ISINCODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(current_code.S_INFO_ISINCODE) != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_securityinfo si WHERE si.wind_code = #{windCode} AND si.security_source = 'temporary' ) AND related.S_INFO_WINDCODE != #{windCode} AND related.S_INFO_WINDCODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(related.S_INFO_WINDCODE) != '' ORDER BY related.S_INFO_WINDCODE
